verdict.rationale: Docs confirm access to H100-class GPUs (with approval) and previous-gen Ampere A100s, plus lower-cost GPU tiers and easy instance-type switching, supporting a mix of current- and prior-gen options. However, there is no evidence of H200 or B200-class GPUs, and community feedback flags network/performance issues on GPU instances that could affect real-world usability. Missing for 10: explicit H200/B200 availability, independent benchmarks confirming current-gen performance, and confirmation that 'largest GPU catalog' claim holds up beyond marketing copy.
